original_source_correction.reason: The preceding sentence defines OPrf[PA](x,y) as the formula representing the decidable proof relation Prf[PA](x,y). The displayed definition of OProv[PA](y) must bind the object-language representing formula, as the same chapter's first-incompleteness-thm.tex:32-34 and rosser-thm.tex:26-27 do. Binding the external relation Prf inside an object-language formula confuses metatheory with arithmetic syntax.
